name: Qitch
description: Constant Q transform pitch follower (sc3-plugins). Frequency-domain pitch tracker using Brown and Puckette's efficient constant Q transform on a quartertone scale (base note F3 = 174.6 Hz), with phase-based fine tuning. Outputs [freq, hasFreq]. Requires a precomputed Qspeckern data buffer matching the output sample rate.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Audio rate input signal to analyze

inputs.name: databufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number holding the QspeckernN<size>SR<rate>.wav initialisation data — must match the output sample rate

inputs.name: ampThreshold
inputs.description: Outputs 0 in hasFreq if the input amplitude is below this threshold

inputs.name: algoflag
inputs.description: 0 = constant Q template pattern matcher only; 1 = enable phase-based refinement

inputs.name: ampbufnum
inputs.description: Optional 11-component buffer with template amplitudes (-1 to use the built-in defaults)

name: Tartini
description: Pitch tracker using the McLeod method (sc3-plugins). Modified autocorrelation calculated via FFT — see McLeod and Wyvill, 'A Smarter Way to Find Pitch' (ICMC 2005). Outputs [freq, hasFreq] where hasFreq is the confidence in the estimate (0 = no fundamental, 1 = fully confident).

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Audio rate input signal to analyze

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Autocorrelation peak-picking threshold — chooses the first peak within this fraction of the maximum peak

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Data window size (without fftw, only 2048, 1024, and 512 are supported, with k = n/2)

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Autocorrelation lags — actual FFT size will be n+k. Pass 0 to use the recommended default of n/2; otherwise keep at most 3n/4

inputs.name: overlap
inputs.description: Overlap size in samples (e.g. 1024 window with 256 overlap advances by 768 samples per frame)

inputs.name: smallCutoff
inputs.description: Minimum height for a peak to be recorded in the autocorrelation function — keep well above zero to avoid spurious peaks
